initial_application: No current git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-29329 was found. Jira FHIR-29329 later recorded Lloyd McKenzie's comment that the change was already done.

Current core source has no active variable extension definition to edit; active ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition narrative pages link to the external extension and already mirror the same-element scope.
